title: BPBond 솔로 #065 · 머슬아워글래스BBW · Yoruba adire eleko pattern · 꿇어앉아 앞 바닥 링 · glossy white lips
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Japanese woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a fierce, playful expression, cool and composed, deep dark brown hair styled in braided, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glossy finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern — a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs, wide cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric bird motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the flagstone floor on its own side in front of her, her arms stretched down and slightly apart.

Pose: kneeling upright on both knees on the flagstone floor, facing the camera, her shoulders drawn back, her chin lifted, her arms stretched down and slightly forward by the chains, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: pointed clear stiletto pumps, each with a thin tapered six-inch heel, her feet resting naturally.

Background & Lighting: the dim torchlight and flickering light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
